correctness_validations.doi_format: Valid DOI syntax and plausible PhysioNet prefix for the root identifier; the citation target conflicts with the root identifier.

correctness_validations.temporal_consistency: Reported release dates are chronologically ordered. Collection and processing dates are insufficiently specified to verify the entire collection-to-publication timeline.
